findings.finding: Catalog-covered strings render in French at runtime; verified via DOM on /sessions, /config, /models.

Hardcoded English strings visible: nav 'Sessions', 'Files', 'System', 'Achievements', 'Kanban' (group), 'Cron'/'Skills' (retained terms); /sessions 'Prune old sessions', 'Import exported sessions', 'Total', 'Active in store', 'Archived', 'Messages', 'Any chat source'; /models 'Model Settings', 'applies to new sessions', 'Main model', 'Auxiliary tasks', 'Change'.
No console errors captured on the pages visited (dev logs empty).
Backend API auth: dashboard served with a fresh temp HOME; protected API calls were not exercised beyond page load.

limitations: Desktop (Electron) app not launched: no interactive GUI smoke on apps/desktop; its fr catalog was validated by typecheck, vitest, and production build only.
Gateway not started (status Off), so session-dependent views (chat, gateway-driven metadata) were not visually exercised.
Screenshots captured but pixel-level review was not possible in this session (vision sidecar unavailable); DOM text evidence is authoritative.
delivery_claim: web catalog localization visually verified; full-product localization not claimed
